description:
List purchases that were cancelled, refunded, or charged back so entitlements can be revoked.

Set `action` to one of:
• list: List voided purchases within an optional time window. — requires: packageName

endTime.description: Upper bound (exclusive) on void time, in epoch milliseconds.

includeQuantityBasedPartialRefund.description: Whether to include voided purchases of quantity-based partial refunds.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return.

startIndex.description: Index of the first result to return.

startTime.description: Lower bound (inclusive) on void time, in epoch milliseconds.

token.description: Pagination token from a previous response.

type.description: Type of voided purchases to return: 0 = voided in-app product purchases only (default); 1 = both voided in-app product and subscription purchases.

name: play_voided_purchases
title: Voided purchases
